articles.headline: Napoli coach Massimiliano Allegri will not appeal touchline ban
articles.description: Napoli coach Massimiliano Allegri will watch Wednesday's Serie A clash with Monza from the stands after deciding not to appeal against his touchline ban.

images.name: Massimiliano Allegri head coach fo Juventus FC gestures during the Coppa Italia 2023/2024 Frecciarossa final match between Atalanta BC and Juventus FC at Stadio Olimpico [1296x729]
